description: Isolated 14-way MobileNetV3 transfer-learning candidate; preparation only

split_policy.train: Only supported_food rows labeled by food_class and non_food rows labeled non_food; unsupported_food rows excluded from fitting.
split_policy.validation: Fit/selection examples are supported_food and non_food; unsupported_food remains a separately reported rejection group. Tune all choices on validation only.
split_policy.test: Use only after the candidate and all settings are frozen on validation. Report supported_food, non_food, and unsupported_food separately. Supported-food membership must exactly match the existing 2,719-image test set.
split_policy.excluded: Never use duplicate_label_conflict rows. Preserve their manifest exclusion status.
split_policy.unsupported_food: Never relabel unsupported foods as non_food; use them only as an explicitly named validation/test evaluation group.

training_plan.input_contract: 224x224 RGB float32 [0,255], NHWC; preserve embedded MobileNetV3 [-1,1] rescaling and production resize/crop contract.
training_plan.initialization: Load the existing 13-class Keras checkpoint, retain its MobileNetV3 feature extractor and preprocessing, replace only the final 13-way classification layer with a new 14-way softmax head.

phase_1.loss: sparse categorical cross-entropy with inverse-frequency per-class sample weights

phase_2_if_validation_justifies.backbone: unfreeze only the final 20 percent of MobileNetV3 layers; keep BatchNormalization layers frozen
phase_2_if_validation_justifies.loss: sparse categorical cross-entropy with inverse-frequency per-class sample weights

training_plan.balancing: Use every available training row with normalized inverse-frequency class weights; do not duplicate or synthetically inflate the broad non_food class. Review per-scene-tag results for concentration.

acceptance_targets.source: Project engineering targets, not reviewer-specified requirements.
acceptance_targets.classification_comparison: Compare 14-way top-1 accuracy on supported foods against the frozen 13-class production model on the same supported split. Acceptance means prediction is any supported food class; classification accuracy additionally requires the predicted food class to be correct.
acceptance_targets.test_policy: Do not use test measurements for model, epoch, augmentation, or threshold selection. Evaluate test once after all candidate choices are frozen on validation.
